traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.summary: Choose a dragon (from the Draconic Ancestors table) that determines your Breath Weapon damage type and Damage Resistance trait.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.summary: Replace one Attack-action attack with an exhalation in a 15-ft Cone or 30-ft Line (DC 8 + Con mod + Prof) dealing 1d10 damage of your ancestry's type, half on save; damage die increases at levels 5/11/17. Uses = Proficiency Bonus, regain on Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.summary: Resistance to the damage type determined by your Draconic Ancestry trait.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.summary: Starting at level 5, Bonus Action to sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes granting a Fly Speed equal to your Speed; once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.summary: Resistance to Poison damage; Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.summary: Hit Point maximum increases by 1, and again by 1 every time you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.summary: Bonus Action to gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes while on or touching stone; uses = Proficiency Bonus, regain on Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.summary: Choose a lineage (Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf) from the Elven Lineages table, granting a level 1 benefit plus higher-level spells at character levels 3 and 5.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.summary: Proficiency in the Insight, Perception, or Survival skill.

traits.name: Trance
traits.summary: Don't need to sleep; can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours by meditating in a trance while retaining consciousness.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.summary: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.summary: Choose Forest Gnome (Minor Illusion cantrip, prepared Speak with Animals spell) or Rock Gnome (Mending and Prestidigitation cantrips, plus Prestidigitation used to craft a Tiny clockwork device).

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.summary: Choose one Giant ancestry benefit (Cloud's Jaunt, Fire's Burn, Frost's Chill, Hill's Tumble, Stone's Endurance, or Storm's Thunder); uses = Proficiency Bonus, regain on Long Rest.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.summary: Starting at level 5, Bonus Action to become Large for 10 minutes (Advantage on Strength checks, Speed +10 ft); once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.summary: Advantage on ability checks to end the Grappled condition; counts as one size larger for carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.summary: Can move through the space of any creature that is a size larger than you, but can't stop there.

traits.name: Luck
traits.summary: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die and must use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.summary: Can take the Hide action when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.summary: Gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.summary: Proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.summary: Gain an Origin feat of your choice (Skilled is recommended).

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.summary: Bonus Action Dash that grants Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus; uses = Proficiency Bonus, regain on Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.summary: When reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, drop to 1 Hit Point instead; once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.summary: Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.summary: Choose a legacy (Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal) from the Fiendish Legacies table, granting a level 1 benefit plus higher-level spells at character levels 3 and 5.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.summary: Know the Thaumaturgy cantrip, cast with the spellcasting ability chosen for your Fiendish Legacy trait.
